about: The six pictures of the Home's area cards (src/components/HomeAreas.astro): the owner's files, byte for byte as supplied.
treatment: None. The files are not cropped, resized, recoloured or recompressed here, and the page applies no filter, blend mode, overlay or opacity to them: they show in their own colours. Only astro:assets, at build time, serves them in smaller sizes and in WebP. A first version (V2.3) had been toned to each card's colour inside the files themselves; that was rejected and removed (V2.3.1), and a test now keeps the files equal to the owner's.

provenance.note: The owner supplied these files; they carry no metadata (author, source, licence, tool). Their origin and the right to publish them were not checked and must be confirmed by the owner before the site is published.

ground.note: Mean of the flat cream at the top and bottom edges of the original (std about 3 levels). The picture is wider than the card (3:2), and cover would cut both heads and half the bubble, so it is shown whole and the card continues this ground.
